description: One-pass implementation of BO AI personal-policy administration plus authenticated Person self-service credential management for AI-associated optional/required API-key and OAuth credentials. Reuse canonical Connect atomic configuration and :people_auth gateway; derive ownership from session; preserve write-only secrets, revoke/remove semantics and session-bound OAuth. Excludes Person-aware Agent runtime resolution/invalidation. Action reuse: extend existing System AI credential configuration, Engine/NodeRouter actions and PeopleCredentials gateway; UI helpers remain local-only; no agent-tool exposure. Tests first: policy/global grant matrix, AI-only eligibility, permission and isolation, secret-free rendering, API key replace, OAuth, revoke/remove, callback failures. Mermaid: graph LR; B[Backend contracts] --> BO[BO policy UI]; B --> P[Person credentials UI]; BO --> V[Validation]; P --> V.
title: Admin and Person credential management UI
